text:
anya: quick sync: spotted multiple places where console labels and in-product help diverge from canonical docs. also a keyboard/aria issue in the help drawer. logging notes here so design/docs/eng can triage.

rachel: can you list high-level pain points? we should be surgical.

anya: short list:
- naming mismatch: console form uses 'model alias' but docs call it 'pinned model' (confuses rollout tutorials)
- help panel depth: some areas embed full how-to, some show 1 sentence + link -> inconsistent experience
- toast links: error toasts have a generic `Help` link that lands on the top of docs, no anchor/utm
- accessibility: help drawer does not expose aria-modal="true" and ESC close isn't consistently firing

tom: i ran a quick clickflow and noticed the toast link doesn't include an anchor or tracking. propose we standardize to include #section anchors and utm_source=console&utm_campaign=help_cta so docs can measure where traffic comes from.

jess: for copy, prefer verbs that map to intent. suggestions:
- inline CTA: "Read more" (opens modal)
- new tab CTA: "Open docs" (opens new tab, tracked)
- toast CTA: "See troubleshooting steps" -> links to /docs/errors#model-load
these map better to analytics events.

docs-bot: creating tracker issue RED-3381 to capture console->docs mapping and UTM standard. linking to docs styleguide.

anya: UX suggestion: make inline help a lightweight paragraph (max 2 lines) + a single CTA. If we need to embed a full how-to for conversion funnels (e.g., onboarding), keep that in a dedicated modal and mark as "expanded docs".

rachel: on naming: which one do we pick? 'Pinned model' seems clearer but 'alias' is entrenched in some SDK examples. we need a backward-compatible plan.

tom: proposal: canonical term = "Pinned model". console UI should show "Pinned model (alias: xyz)" when an alias exists for backward compatibility. docs + SDK examples get a migration note and a deprecation window.

jess: agree. copy snippet for form label + helper:```
Label: Pinned model
Helper: Select the exact model version used for this route. Pin to avoid automatic upgrades.
Deprecation note (SDK): `model_alias` will be renamed to `pinned_model` from 2026-05-01.
```

a11y-bot: accessibility notes: include aria-modal="true" on the drawer, set focus to first actionable item, ensure ESC triggers the same close callback as the close button. Also expose `role="dialog"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing to the drawer title.

anya: engineers, can you add a small e2e to assert ESC closes the drawer and focus returns to the help icon? we should capture VoiceOver/NVDA checks as well.

tom: will add test. also will add anchor ids to long doc sections we want to reference (quantization, rollouts, caching). linking pattern: /docs/{slug}#{section-id}.

rachel: docs team, we need a one-pager mapping console labels -> canonical doc terms + recommended CTA copy + tracking query params. can you produce by EOD?

docs-bot: assigned RED-3381 to docs-squad, ETA: 2 business days. attaching mapping template.

jess: tiny UX nit on outline styles: the help drawer currently hides focus outlines (css reset). propose we restore 2px visible outline for keyboard users and 3:1 contrast ratio.

a11y-bot: also request keyboard-only users get skip links: "Skip to content" inside the drawer to jump past boilerplate.

tom: prioritization suggestion: P0: help drawer ESC/focus (accessibility violation), P1: canonicalize 'Pinned model' term + docs/SDK migration, P2: anchor links + UTM tracking, P3: inline-summary pattern + styling.

rachel: ok. does anyone object to the naming plan?

jess: no objections. i'll draft the copy variants and a short FAQ blurb for SDK devs.

a11y-bot: logging test matrix for screen readers on mac/chrome + windows/firefox + NVDA. adding to RED-3381.

anya: thanks. i'll create a tiny Figma spec for the inline-summary + modal behavior. will ping when ready.

tom: one last ops note: please add a short log line when a user clicks a docs CTA (console telemetry) so product can see which topics get clicked from which pages. keep payload minimal: {page, section_id, cta_type}.

docs-bot: noted. RED-3381 updated with telemetry field suggestions.

rachel: great thread. i'll convert these into action items in the design doc and link RED-3381. thanks folks :raised_hands:
